invalid-owner.title: "{{name}}" is not a valid service name
invalid-owner.detail: RFC 2782 spells the owner of an SRV record _service._protocol, as in _sip._tcp. Software looking for the service will never find it under any other name.

unavailable-with-others.title: A target of "." cannot coexist with a real one
unavailable-with-others.detail: RFC 2782 uses a target of "." to say the service is decidedly not available. Either remove it, or make it the only record of the set.

invalid-target.title: Invalid target "{{target}}"
invalid-target.detail: The target of an SRV record must be a valid host name, or "." to declare the service unavailable.

invalid-priority.title: Priority "{{value}}" is out of range
invalid-priority.detail: The priority of an SRV record is a 16-bit unsigned integer (0..65535). The lowest one wins.

invalid-weight.title: Weight "{{value}}" is out of range
invalid-weight.detail: The weight of an SRV record is a 16-bit unsigned integer (0..65535). It shares the load between the records of a same priority.

invalid-port.title: Port "{{value}}" is out of range
invalid-port.detail: A port number is a 16-bit unsigned integer (0..65535).

port-zero.title: Port 0 on a real target
port-zero.detail: Port 0 is not a port a service can listen on. Use the port of the service, or a target of "." to declare it unavailable.

target-is-cname.title: Target "{{target}}" is an alias
target-is-cname.detail: RFC 2782 requires the target of an SRV record to be a host name, never a CNAME.

target-no-address.title: Target "{{target}}" has no A/AAAA in this zone
target-no-address.detail: Add a Server entry for this name, or check that the target FQDN is correct.

duplicate.title: Duplicate target "{{target}}" on port {{port}}
duplicate.detail: The same host and port appear more than once. Keep only one record.

zero-weight-mixed.title: A weight of 0 next to non-zero ones at priority {{priority}}
zero-weight-mixed.detail: Within a priority level, the load is shared in proportion to the weights: a record weighing 0 is only ever picked when every other one at that level is unreachable. Give it a weight if you meant it to take a share of the traffic.

UnknownSRV.name: Service Record
UnknownSRV.description: Indicates to dedicated software the existance of the given service in the domain.
